# Rachit Mangawa

> Systems and AI Engineer specializing in high-throughput backend architecture, local AI runtimes, bare-metal C++ compilers, and low-latency data infrastructure.

## Skills and Architecture
- Languages: Python, C/C++, TypeScript, SQL, Bash
- GenAI and NLP: LLMs (Ollama, gemma3), RAG Pipelines, Vector Search (FAISS, BM25), Cross-Encoder Reranking, Hugging Face Transformers, Sentence-Transformers
- Machine Learning and Vision: PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, SHAP, OpenCV, OCR (Tesseract)
- Backend and Web: FastAPI, Next.js, REST APIs, WebSockets, SQLAlchemy, SQLite, JWT and RBAC
- Data Engineering and Tools: ETL Pipelines, Pandas, NumPy, Plotly Dash, Docker, Git, GitHub Actions, PyTest, Linux

## Key Systems
- HeartFlow OS: ML platform exporting trained models to zero-dependency C++ for ESP32 microcontrollers.
- Semantic Comment Analyzer: Real-time intent-driven NLP pipeline with occlusion attribution and sub-15ms inference.
